roles.name: Data Analyst
roles.description: Translates business questions into quantitative insights through exploratory analysis, SQL data modeling, visual analytics, and stakeholder dashboards.
available_gaps: Advanced SQL (Window functions, CTEs, query optimization)
Python Data Wrangling (Pandas, Polars, Data Cleaning)

roles.name: Data Engineer
roles.description: Architects, constructs, and maintains robust data processing pipelines, ETL/ELT workflows, data warehouses, and streaming infrastructure.
available_gaps: Cloud Storage & Lakehouses (AWS S3, Databricks, Snowflake)

roles.name: AI Engineer
roles.description: Integrates machine learning models, modern LLMs, vector search, and agentic workflows into production software applications.

roles.name: AI/Product Analyst
roles.description: Bridges machine learning capabilities and product outcomes, evaluating feature impact, user behavior, latency/cost tradeoffs, and AI quality metrics.
available_gaps: AI Feature Performance Metrics (Perplexity, Hallucination Rate, Latency)

time_tiers.label: 15+ hours/week
time_tiers.project_scale: Comprehensive System Build with Full CI/CD (25+ hrs total)

experience_levels.label: Beginner / Career Switcher
experience_levels.modifier: Emphasizes foundational mechanics, step-by-step validation, and clean baseline reproducibility.

experience_levels.label: Intermediate / Practitioner
experience_levels.modifier: Emphasizes edge-case handling, modular architecture, and industry-standard tooling.

experience_levels.label: Advanced / Senior
experience_levels.modifier: Emphasizes distributed scalability, latency optimization, unit economics, and formal production deployment.

outcome_goals.label: Portfolio Showcase
outcome_goals.focus: Public GitHub repository with comprehensive README, live interactive demo, and clear documentation.

outcome_goals.label: Work Promotion / Work Deliverable
outcome_goals.focus: Immediate application to real internal datasets with executive-ready ROI business summary.

outcome_goals.label: Concept Mastery
outcome_goals.focus: Deep mathematical and programmatic intuition without reliance on black-box boilerplate.

outcome_goals.label: Career Switch Proof
outcome_goals.focus: Proof-of-work artifact that answers typical technical interview take-home challenges.

tier_low.title: E-Commerce Customer Retention & Churn Diagnostic
tier_low.description: Analyze transactional purchase logs to identify drop-off points, cohort retention curves, and high-value customer cohorts using pure SQL and a clean visualization deck.
tier_low.tools: DuckDB / PostgreSQL, Pandas, Seaborn or Tableau Public
tier_low.sample_data: Online Retail II public dataset or Brazilian E-Commerce public dataset (Olist)
tier_low.deliverable: A structured SQL script with CTEs + an executive 3-slide visual deck outlining churn drivers and recommendations.

tier_mid.title: SaaS Subscription Cohort & LTV Decomposition Dashboard
tier_mid.description: Build an end-to-end cohort retention and MRR waterfall analysis modeling churn risk, expansion revenue, and customer lifetime value across acquisition channels.
tier_mid.tools: PostgreSQL, Python (Pandas/Polars), Streamlit or Power BI
tier_mid.sample_data: Synthesized B2B SaaS subscription billing records (50,000+ rows)
tier_mid.deliverable: Interactive dashboard with dynamic date sliders, retention heatmaps, and automated cohort calculation queries.

tier_high.title: Real-Time Marketplace Pricing & Demand Elasticity Analysis
tier_high.description: Formulate econometric regression models and an automated reporting workflow analyzing ride-hailing or hotel surge pricing dynamics and elasticity.
tier_high.sample_data: Public TLC Trip Record Data or Open Airbnb Listings data
tier_high.deliverable: Reproducible Jupyter notebook with econometric hypothesis tests, causal sanity checks, and a production dashboard.

tier_ultra.title: Enterprise Financial Analytics Engine & Automated Anomaly Detection
tier_ultra.description: Construct an automated daily data audit and anomaly detection system for payment transactions, complete with email alerts and statistical process control.
tier_ultra.tools: SQL, Python, DuckDB, Metabase / Superset, GitHub Actions
tier_ultra.sample_data: Kaggle Credit Card Fraud & Transaction Logs
tier_ultra.deliverable: Automated pipeline running via CI/CD that extracts data, detects outliers, and pushes an updated reporting summary.

tier_low.title: Local SQLite to DuckDB ELT Pipeline with dbt Core
tier_low.description: Transform messy raw transactional CSVs into a dimensional Kimball star schema using dbt Core and DuckDB with automated schema tests.
tier_low.deliverable: A clean Git repo with documented dbt models, lineage DAG, and automated generic & singular tests.

tier_mid.title: Automated Weather & Air Quality Lakehouse Pipeline
tier_mid.description: Build an idempotent daily API ingestion pipeline extracting public environmental data, writing to partitioned Parquet, and serving SQL queries.
tier_mid.tools: Python, Prefect / Airflow, DuckDB / MinIO S3, PyArrow
tier_mid.deliverable: Dockerized orchestrator running daily ingest with retries, partition validation, and data quality check reporting.

tier_high.title: Streaming Event Ingestion & Windowed Analytics Engine
tier_high.description: Stream clickstream events into a message broker, process aggregations with stream processing, and persist to an analytical columnar store.
tier_high.tools: Apache Kafka (or Redpanda), Spark Streaming / Bytewax, ClickHouse / DuckDB
tier_high.sample_data: Real-time synthetic IoT sensor or web event generator
tier_high.deliverable: Complete docker-compose stack with producer, real-time tumbling window consumer, and zero-data-loss validation test.

tier_ultra.title: Enterprise Cloud Lakehouse with Delta Lake, dbt, & CI/CD
tier_ultra.description: Deploy a multi-hop (Bronze/Silver/Gold) architecture utilizing Delta Lake or Apache Iceberg with Great Expectations data quality gates.
tier_ultra.tools: Delta Lake, dbt Core, Apache Spark, GitHub Actions, MinIO
tier_ultra.deliverable: Production repository featuring CI/CD automated linting (SQLFluff), schema drift detection, and automated backfill tooling.

tier_low.title: Document QA RAG API with Vector Search & Citation Guardrails
tier_low.description: Develop a lightweight Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system that answers questions over technical PDF documentation with exact source page citations.
tier_low.tools: Python, FastAPI, ChromaDB / FAISS, Sentence-Transformers, HuggingFace Inference
tier_low.sample_data: Public cloud provider API documentation or financial quarterly 10-K filings
tier_low.deliverable: FastAPI endpoint accepting user queries and returning semantic answers with verifiable paragraph citations and confidence metrics.

tier_mid.title: Production RAG Service with Hybrid Search & Re-ranking
tier_mid.description: Build a production RAG application featuring hybrid BM25 + dense vector search, Cross-Encoder re-ranking, and automated chunking evaluation.
tier_mid.tools: FastAPI, Qdrant / Weaviate, LangChain / LlamaIndex, Docker
tier_mid.deliverable: Dockerized container with streaming responses, conversation memory, hallucination check guardrails, and latency logs.

tier_high.title: Agentic Tool-Calling Workflow with Evaluation Benchmark
tier_high.description: Construct an autonomous multi-step reasoning agent capable of querying external SQL databases, calculating metrics in Python, and returning validated answers.
tier_high.tools: FastAPI, LangGraph / CrewAI, SQLite, Ragas / TruLens, Docker
tier_high.sample_data: Company sales database + external currency exchange API
tier_high.deliverable: Agentic service with execution traces, loop-prevention guards, and an automated benchmark testing 50 complex multi-hop queries.

tier_ultra.title: Domain-Specific LLM Fine-Tuning & Quantized Inference Server
tier_ultra.description: Fine-tune an open-source model (e.g. Llama-3-8B or Mistral) on custom instruction-response pairs using QLoRA, evaluate against test splits, and serve with vLLM.
tier_ultra.tools: PyTorch, HuggingFace TRL, PEFT, Unsloth, vLLM, Docker
tier_ultra.sample_data: Specialized legal or medical Q&A dataset
tier_ultra.deliverable: Fine-tuning loss curves, automated ROUGE/BLEU & LLM-as-judge benchmark, and an optimized sub-second inference container.

tier_low.title: AI Feature Latency, Token Cost & Quality Audit Report
tier_low.description: Perform an empirical benchmark comparing 3 foundation models across response latency, prompt token overhead, cost-per-query, and output accuracy.
tier_low.sample_data: Standardized benchmark prompt suite (100 synthetic customer service prompts)
tier_low.deliverable: Executive memo and cost sensitivity matrix showing projected monthly operational costs at 10k, 100k, and 1M queries.

tier_mid.title: AI Search Feature A/B Test Design & Conversion Attribution
tier_mid.description: Design and simulate a randomized controlled trial (A/B test) evaluating the conversion impact of an AI-powered conversational search bar vs traditional keyword search.
tier_mid.sample_data: Simulated e-commerce search logs with session durations and purchase flags
tier_mid.deliverable: Full experiment design document: sample size power calculations, Minimum Detectable Effect (MDE), guardrail metrics, and simulated analysis script.

tier_high.title: Comprehensive LLM Guardrail & Hallucination Telemetry Pipeline
tier_high.description: Instrument a live telemetry dashboard tracking toxicity, hallucination rates, user sentiment, and fallback rates for a customer-facing AI assistant.
tier_high.tools: Python, Prometheus / OpenTelemetry, Grafana / Streamlit, TruLens
tier_high.sample_data: Synthetic conversation logs with labeled edge-case failures
tier_high.deliverable: Real-time dashboard visualizing error budgets, user drop-off triggers, and automated alert criteria.

tier_ultra.title: Causal Impact & Unit Economic Valuation of Enterprise AI
tier_ultra.description: Conduct a Difference-in-Differences and Synthetic Control analysis evaluating the operational productivity lift of an internal AI coding or support tool.
tier_ultra.tools: R / Python (CausalPy, DoWhy), DuckDB, Quarto / Markdown
tier_ultra.sample_data: Historical team velocity, ticket resolution time, and cost records across 12 months
tier_ultra.deliverable: Econometric report detailing causal effect estimation, placebo tests, and sensitivity analysis presented in an executive whitepaper.

dimensions.name: Data Hygiene & Reproducibility
dimensions.beginner: Code runs with minor manual path edits; basic error handling; instructions present in README.
dimensions.proficient: Fully reproducible environment (requirements.txt / Pipfile); automated seed initialization; zero hardcoded credentials.
dimensions.production_ready: One-command Docker containerization; automated schema validation; comprehensive unit tests with CI workflow.

dimensions.name: Methodological Rigor
dimensions.beginner: Applies standard textbook library calls; understands primary metrics (accuracy, precision, RMSE).
dimensions.proficient: Validates assumptions (baseline comparisons, cross-validation, data leakage prevention); isolates edge cases.
dimensions.production_ready: Benchmarked against realistic cost/latency tradeoffs; statistical significance testing; automated regression guardrails.

dimensions.name: Business & Engineering Communication
dimensions.beginner: Outputs raw charts and code logs; identifies what the model or pipeline does.
dimensions.proficient: Translates technical metrics into concrete business implications; creates clean, readable architectural visual.
dimensions.production_ready: Executive-ready documentation highlighting unit economics, failure recovery procedures, and measurable ROI impact.

provider_questions.question: What proportion of the hands-on projects require building from scratch vs. filling in missing lines in pre-configured Jupyter notebooks?
provider_questions.why_it_matters: Pre-filled notebooks create an illusion of competence that quickly breaks down in technical coding interviews and real production settings.

provider_questions.question: Does this program grant official alumni status, an institutional university email, or degree credits with the partnering university, or strictly a certificate of completion from their continuing education arm?
provider_questions.why_it_matters: Marketing logos frequently suggest regular university association while legal contracts explicitly state continuing education status only.

provider_questions.question: Is the quoted price inclusive of 18% GST, examination proctoring fees, platform access extension fees, and loan origination charges?
provider_questions.why_it_matters: Unadvertised taxes and financing charges regularly add ₹35,000 to ₹60,000 to the real out-of-pocket tuition cost.

provider_questions.question: Who grades the capstone project—the tenured university professors shown on the brochure, or outsourced teaching assistants? What rubric is used for code review?
provider_questions.why_it_matters: Syllabus marketing highlights distinguished professors, but daily code evaluations are almost exclusively handled by junior third-party contractors.

provider_questions.question: What was the unadjusted placement percentage of the most recently graduated cohort, excluding students who were already employed in data/AI roles prior to enrolling?
provider_questions.why_it_matters: Reported 'salary hikes' and 'placement rates' are routinely inflated by counting existing tech workers who received routine corporate increments.
